content: A Vue 3 SPA component library for a Material 3 redesign should separate layout primitives from feature components. Primitives live in a design-system folder (e.g., app/frontend/components/stitch/) and include Surface, Text, Button, Badge, Skeleton, Icon, and Avatar components that wrap Tailwind utility classes mapped to the M3 token system. Feature components (GameCard, SessionHeader, SuggestionCard, GroupHero, MemberPanel) consume these primitives. Use CSS custom properties for dynamic elevation/surface tones and Vue transition for ripple/skeleton states. Keep server data out of these components: they receive props and emit events, while Apollo composables live in views or dedicated useX composables.
